content.title: UConn beats Notre Dame to reach Final Four behind Blanca Quiñonez: Live updates and reaction from NCAA women's March Madness Elite Eight
content.text: UConn's bid to win a second straight national title is alive after the Huskies knocked off the Fighting Irish in the NCAA TournamentUConn is headed back to the Final Four as it looks to close out Notre Dame. Getty Images UConn headed to 25th Final Four Getty ImagesUConn is headed to the Final Four for the 25th time after its 70-52 win over Notre Dame today. Check out our coverage from Cameron Teague Robinson.SKIP ADVERTISEMENTAdvertisement Chantel Jennings / The AthleticKK Arnold and Kyrie Irving embrace after the Huskies’ win.Final scoring leaders Getty Images Below are the final scoring leaders for today’s UConn and Notre Dame game: Notre Dame: Hannah Hidalgo (22 points, 7-of-19 FG)UConn: Sarah Strong (21 points, 6-of-13 FG) Have a game, Blanca Quiñonez Getty ImagesWhat a performance for Blanca Quiñonez today.She definitely was UConn’s best player. Playing 30 minutes off the bench, Quiñonez had 20 points on 7-of-12 shooting from the floor. She added eight rebounds and made four 3s. UConn coach Geno Auriemma doesn’t usually go to his bench often, but today he did, and Quiñonez shone. Sarah Strong reaches 20 points againIt was a slow start for UConn sophomore star Sarah Strong. But she finished with another 20-point game.Strong notched 21 points on 6-of-13 shooting from the floor, along with two 3s. It is the 31st 20-point game for Strong over the course of her first two seasons at UConn.That puts Strong in a tie with UConn legend Breanna Stewart for the most 20-point games in the first two seasons in program history. Another Final Four for UConn Getty ImagesWith the Huskies win today, it is UConn‘s 25th women’s Final Four appearance as a program.UConn has reached the women‘s Final Four in 17 of the last 18 seasons.Incredible consistency! SKIP ADVERTISEMENTAdvertisementSarah Strong: 'It was definitely a fight'Sarah Strong spoke about UConn facing a rival in Notre Dame, the team’s response in the second half and how connected the Huskies are. 💬 “It was definitely a fight. We didn’t come out ready. They put up a fight.”💬 “We just couldn’t play worse in the first half.” 💬 “We love each other, we play for each other.”FINAL: UConn to the Final Four Getty ImagesQ4 0:00 - UConn 70, Notre Dame 52That will do it. UConn’s perfect season continues.The Huskies trounce Notre Dame to advance to the women’s Final Four. UConn had a slow start but rounded into form in the second half, outscoring Notre Dame 38-27. Fudd, Strong sub outQ4 0:30.7 - UConn 70, Notre Dame 52Azzi Fudd and Sarah Strong sub out of the game with under a minute to go.A roaring ovation for both of UConn’s star players. Q4 2:39 - UConn 65, Notre Dame 50To Cameron’s point, give credit to Hannah Hidalgo. She is doing all she can for Notre Dame, leading the team with 22 points. It’s just undefeated UConn is that good! Notre Dame can't keep up Getty ImagesNotre Dame just doesn't have enough firepower to come back in this one. Sarah Strong and Azzi Fudd have started scoring and nobody else on Notre Dame, other than Hannah Hidalgo, has scored in double figures today.SKIP ADVERTISEMENTAdvertisementQ4 4:46 - UConn 63, Notre Dame 46The broadcast just showed a graphic that UConn’s Sarah Strong has touched the ball on every possession in the fourth quarter.That’s bonkers! UConn still up double digitsQ4 5:23 - UConn 63, Notre Dame 46Notre Dame just can’t close the deficit against UConn.The Huskies lead by 17 with five minutes left in this game.Fantastic penetration from Azzi Fudd, setting up the Blanca Quiñonez triple. Quiñonez has a game-high 20 points. UConn dominating Getty ImagesQ4 7:14 - UConn 54, Notre Dame 40Sarah Strong! She’s feeling it.The UConn star drains a 24-foot 3-pointer. Looked so confident with that shooting stroke too.UConn leads by 14. Notre Dame has no answers. Q4 9:20 - UConn 49, Notre Dame 36The fourth quarter begins with an Azzi Fudd field goal.Fudd has eight points on 4-of-10 shooting from the floor.UConn leads by 13. UConn too good Getty ImagesNotre Dame has done just about everything it can to stay in this game, but the machine that is UConn might be beginning to wear the Irish down. The Huskies are leading 47-36 going into the fourth and face guarding Hidalgo at all costs. Somebody else for Notre Dame is going to have to step up.SKIP ADVERTISEMENTAdvertisementEnd Q3: UConn up 11Q3 0:00 - UConn 47, Notre Dame 36UConn goes to the fourth quarter with an 11-point lead over Notre Dame. Sarah Strong gets a critical 3-pointer in the closing moments of the third quarter. UConn began the third quarter 2-of-13 from the field. Since then, 3-of-4. The Huskies are closing in on another women’s Final Four appearance. Q3 2:04 - UConn 42, Notre Dame 33Every time Notre Dame cuts the deficit, UConn pulls away.The Huskies are up nine with two minutes to go in the third quarter. The UConn offense isn’t putting up amazing numbers (40 percent FG, 22 percent 3FG) but maintains a sizeable lead.It’s just Notre Dame isn’t taking advantage. Getty ImagesQ3 2:42 - UConn 40, Notre Dame 33Hannah Hidalgo gets a huge and-one for Notre Dame.She has all eight of Notre Dame’s points in the third quarter.The Fighting Irish cut the deficit to seven against UConn. UConn up 10Q3 3:44 - UConn 40, Notre Dame 30Jana El Alfy didn’t play in the first half. She comes off the bench and makes her presence known, getting a critical layup.The Huskies retain their 10-point lead.
